paragraphs: My name is Ben. I am nine. I live next to the school. I like football a lot. Here are my days. On Monday, a man comes to our school. He plays football with the kids. The man is nice. On Tuesday, we run and kick the ball. On Wednesday, we play a big game. We have fun.

On Thursday, I read a book about football. On Friday, I play with Tom in the park. Tom is my friend. We kick the ball to Pip. Pip jumps and runs. Pip says, "Woof!" On Saturday, Dad and I look at a game. It is on television. Dad says, "Go, go, go!" I say, "Go, go, go!" too.
On Sunday, I sleep a lot. Then I go to bed at night. Football is my favorite game. Do you like football? Which day is your favorite? I like Monday. Then I see the man again!
text.summary: Ben tells us about his week. He plays football on some days and rests on Sunday.
